relatedTemplates.name: Create Task with Priority
relatedTemplates.query: mutation CreateTask($title: String!, $priority: Int!, $dueDate: String!) { createNode(input: { tableId: "2", content: $title, metadata: { priority: $priority, dueDate: $dueDate } }) { id } }
relatedTemplates.usagePattern: Task creation with priority and deadline

relatedTemplates.name: Bulk Task Status Update
relatedTemplates.query: mutation BulkUpdateTasks($nodeIds: [String!]!, $status: String!) { bulkUpdateNodes(input: { nodeIds: $nodeIds, updates: { status: $status } }) { success count } }
relatedTemplates.usagePattern: Mass status updates with transaction safety
